info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Market Analysis Reviews API
info.description: The Financial Market Analysis Reviews API allows users to submit and contribute reviews related to market performance and financial products. This API is essential for financial analysts and market researchers who need to gather insights and opinions to enhance investment strategies. By providing a platform to share experiences and assessments, the API facilitates better decision-making in financial markets. Businesses can leverage this data to improve their offerings and tailor their services based on client feedback.

post.summary: Create a review for financial market analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified financial market analysis resource (RES-100045). It is intended to gather user feedback and insights that can enhance the quality and applicability of the analysis provided.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for the financial market analysis resource identified by RES-100045. It must contain structured data that aligns with the defined schema for reviews, allowing users to provide feedback and opinions that can be processed and analyzed. Ensure that all required fields are present and properly formatted according to the specified schema.
